fnol_text: My name is Ravi Abernathy and I live at 682 Larkspur Close, Milton, VT 05432. You can reach me on (555) 705-3237 or ravi.abernathy@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 11 September 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors.
